collection.description: A family gathers to decorate lanterns with shells and colored fibers.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A family gathers to decorate lanterns with shells and colored fibers. Someone suggests a different pattern, and the work becomes a lively conversation.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A family gathers to decorate lanterns with shells and colored fibers. (Name1) is looking forward to showing the finished work to a friend.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A family gathers to decorate lanterns with shells and colored fibers. For a little while, everyone forgets how tiring the day has been.

e2__fx.name: Ending 2
e2__fx.text: A family gathers to decorate lanterns with shells and colored fibers. The warm glow makes the ordinary evening feel like a celebration.
